action_timing.recurrent_state: all within-decision queries use pre-decision hidden; final query candidate commits once at the decision boundary
action_timing.threshold_crossing_effect: a crossing schedules its selected input at query_time + motor_delay_ms
action_timing.deadline_rule: only scheduled inputs arriving at or before the decision deadline can select the current decision action
action_timing.top2_definition: second-largest probability among all six unmasked actions; a tie for top1 yields zero margin

aoi.overlapping_preview_allocation: equal duration split across matched H1-H4 future steps
aoi.sensitivity_use: separate output only; never mixed into primary human_reference

change_policy: Any metric-definition, policy-sampling, or regression-target change requires a new contract version; do not edit contract_v5 in place.

checkpoint_pairing.tau_calibration_anchor: 2400-ms ActionNet with an explicitly confirmed matching GazeNet

first_new_saccade.distance: Euclidean board-tile distance from preceding physical fixation

process_eligibility.rule: participant session mean gaze validity >= .80 AND trial mean gaze validity >= .90 AND exactly 180 decisions

post_first_input_fraction.aggregation: participant x Time x Preview duration ratio-of-sums, then participant marginal mean by Time
post_first_input_fraction.denominator: classified gaze duration from onset to execution
post_first_input_fraction.numerator: classified gaze duration from literal first input to execution

post_selected_action_fraction.aggregation: participant x Time x Preview duration ratio-of-sums, then participant marginal mean by Time
post_selected_action_fraction.denominator: classified gaze duration from onset to execution
post_selected_action_fraction.numerator: classified gaze duration from resolved selected-action input to execution

revision.canonical_had_revision: first selected action != final selected action among non-timeout decisions
revision.temporal_diagnostic: store every change of current selected action

selected_action_input.first_not_final: first delayed input timestamp at which the eventual final action became current
selected_action_input.only_one_input_record: timestamp of the available delayed input

semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.coverage_type: nonexclusive semantic/foveal coverage; not an AOI composition
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.decision_coverage: binary per AOI per decision; a trial reports checked decisions / 180
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.fixation_hit: count once when a new physical fixation starts; repeated fixation starts in one decision count again
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.footprint: fixation center plus the four cardinally adjacent in-bounds tiles
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.hit_rate: AOI-hit physical fixation starts / interval duration in ms
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.hit_share: AOI-hit physical fixation starts / all physical fixation starts in the interval
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.nonexclusive_rule: Self, Partner, and Preview are independently marked when their masks intersect the PLUS footprint
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.other_rule: Other is marked only when none of Self, Partner, or Preview intersects the PLUS footprint
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.pre_window: decision onset <= physical fixation start < selected-action input
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.post_window: selected-action input <= physical fixation start < execution/deadline
semantic_foveal_plus_coverage.post_timeout_rule: forced timeouts are excluded; intentional STAY with a selected input is included

collision.action_scope: learner cardinal movement actions only; STAY and INTERACT are excluded
collision.environment_block: learner terrain-constrained candidate position equals its old position and no partner collision occurred
collision.partner_collision: the joint pre-transition candidate positions collide or swap according to mdp.is_transition_collision
collision.separation: partner_collision and environment_block are mutually exclusive

stay.forced: no threshold-qualified motor input arrives by the deadline; execute STAY
stay.intentional: STAY itself crosses threshold and its delayed input arrives by the deadline
stay.no_action_rate: forced_stay OR intentional_stay; reported in addition to both components

opportunity_adjusted_gee.formula: outcome ~ Time + Preview + Layout + trial_order_c + event_window_input_fraction + event_length_decisions

windows.post_first_input: literal first delayed input to execution/deadline
windows.post_selected_action: resolved delayed selected-action input to execution/deadline

policy_sampling.gaze_rng: torch.Generator(device='cpu') seeded with environment_seed + 77003 independently in every Time x Horizon x episode rollout
policy_sampling.action_policy: deterministic top1 action after the top1-top2 margin threshold is satisfied
policy_sampling.purpose: Preserve learned stochastic visual exploration while retaining an interpretable confidence-threshold action and motor-delay contract
